teile.text: These seven AI models are free to download right now.

Number seven is VisionHOPE. This tool automatically categorizes your images into specific groups so you can organize your photo library without manual work. It has over one thousand two hundred downloads on Hugging Face.
teile.name: VisionHOPE

teile.text: Number six is Contrastive-LM. It ranks different pieces of text to find the most relevant match for your needs. It is useful for finding specific information in large documents and has nearly three thousand downloads.
teile.name: Contrastive-LM

teile.text: Number five is Clef by Cloudflare. This model reads pictures and answers questions about what is inside them in plain English. It currently has over eight hundred likes from the community.
teile.name: Cloudflare Clef

teile.text: Number four is Qwen-Image. It creates high quality images from a simple text description. It is a powerful open source alternative for creators and has over eighty-one thousand downloads.
teile.name: Qwen-Image

teile.text: Number three is Laya. This model sorts text into different categories automatically, which is perfect for organizing feedback or emails. It has already earned five thousand likes.
teile.name: Laya

teile.text: Number two is LTX-2.5. It turns static images into moving videos with realistic motion. This tool is a favorite for video creators and has over one point five million downloads.
teile.name: LTX-2.5

teile.text: Finally, number one is Qwen-3.8-27B. It reads pictures and answers complex questions about them with incredible accuracy. It is the most popular model on our list with nearly seven million downloads.
